dataset.name: OULAD
dataset.description: Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (United Kingdom, 2013-2014; CC BY 4.0; UCI id 349). NOT Indian data.

kaplan_meier.population: training presentations; registrations present at week 1 with a known withdrawal week

academic.target: Fail or Withdrawn at course end, predicted every week

P1.description: XGBoost oulad-ts-1.0.0 minus XGBoost v2 features, test PR-AUC (one-sided)

P2.description: best sequence model (lstm) minus XGBoost oulad-ts-1.0.0, test PR-AUC (two-sided)

P4.description: student-level false-alarm rate, raw minus 2-consecutive-week policy (F1 threshold, one-sided)

alerts.deployment_policy_rule: consecutive_2 if it loses at most 0.02 student-level recall vs raw, else raw

equal_opportunity_gender.note: analysis only: using gender at decision time is an institutional, ethical and legal choice

demographics_as_inputs.note: sensitivity analysis only; SEWS does not use demographics as model inputs

hazard_model.label: withdraws in the next week (discrete-time hazard)

rolling_origin.note: hyperparameters fixed from the hold-out validation (2014B); the fold testing on 2014B is optimistic

P5.description: degradation(L1 logistic) - degradation(XGBoost) per unseen module; one-sided exact Wilcoxon

lomo.scope: Cross-MODULE proxy within one UK institution; not cross-institution validation.
